Input:varQuery.title: varQuery
Input:varQuery.description: The analyst's policy question — the topic to search for, e.g. "debt service coverage ratio for secured business loans."

Input:varLoanSegment.title: varLoanSegment
Input:varLoanSegment.description: The policy-file prefix selecting the applicable segment, built as PrimeCapital_Policy_{SecurityType}_{BorrowerType}% from the applicant's Security Type and Borrower Type — e.g. Secured + Business → PrimeCapital_Policy_Secured_Business%. Always include the trailing %.

outputLanguage.title: Output language
outputLanguage.description: Optional. Specify the response language using the appropriate two-character language code or five-character locale code (for example, en_US, en_GB, es, es_MX).

isPreviewOnly.title: Preview Only
isPreviewOnly.description: Resolves the prompt template without generating an LLM response.
